name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from the Government of India. It provides income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to assist them in meeting their agricultural and domestic financial needs.
benefits: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year per family, payable in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of eligible farmer families via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

conditions.label: Primary Occupation is Agriculture / Farming
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must be a farmer with cultivable landholding.

conditions.label: Possession of Cultivable Landholding
conditions.failure_message: Applicant family must possess cultivable agricultural land registered in their name.

conditions.label: Not an Income Tax Payer
conditions.failure_message: Individuals who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded from PM-KISAN.

conditions.label: Not an Institutional Landholder
conditions.failure_message: Institutional landholders are not eligible.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Mandatory for identity verification and biometric e-KYC

required_documents.name: Landholding Documents / Khasra-Khatauni
required_documents.description: Official land record showing ownership of cultivable land

required_documents.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook / Account Details
required_documents.description: Bank account linked with NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer

required_documents.name: Active Mobile Number
required_documents.description: For OTP authentication during eKYC and status notifications

application_steps: Step 1: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in) and navigate to the 'Farmer Corner'.
Step 2: Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and choose Rural or Urban Farmer Registration.
Step 3: Enter your Aadhaar Number, mobile number, and select your state. Verify using OTP.
Step 4: Fill in personal details, land records details (Survey/Khata Number, Khasra Number, Area in Hectare), and bank details.
Step 5: Upload supporting land document copy and submit the application for local revenue authority verification.
Step 6: Complete mandatory e-KYC either via OTP on the portal or biometric authentication at a Common Service Center (CSC).

sources.source_name: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India

investigation.summary: PM-KISAN is one of the world's largest DBT cash transfer schemes. Regular audits ensure only genuine small and marginal landholders receive payments.
findings: Eligibility is strictly tied to verifiable revenue land records in the farmer's name.
Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural laborers are currently excluded.
Constitutional post holders, serving/retired government employees (except Group D/Multi Tasking Staff), and doctors/engineers/lawyers are excluded.
fraud_alerts: Beware of fraudulent WhatsApp/SMS links promising ₹2,000 extra bonus or immediate approval on payment of registration fees. Government never charges registration fees.
Never share bank OTP or Aadhaar OTP with unauthorized callers claiming to update your PM-KISAN eKYC.
investigation.missing_information: State-specific land mutation delays can sometimes delay beneficiary listing despite valid registration.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
description: AB-PMJAY is the flagship public health insurance scheme of the Government of India, providing cashless access to secondary and tertiary healthcare services across empaneled public and private hospitals nationwide.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care. Over 1,900 medical procedures covered, including pre-existing conditions from day one, diagnostics, medicines, and 15 days post-hospitalization care.

conditions.label: Covered under SECC 2011 or Priority Household / Antyodaya Ration Card
conditions.failure_message: Family must be listed in SECC 2011 depository or state-expanded NFSA beneficiary databases.

conditions.label: Needs Ayushman Bharat Card Generation
conditions.failure_message: Family can generate Ayushman card if listed in the eligible census/ration database.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Mandatory for biometric identity validation of patient

required_documents.name: Ration Card / NFSA Card
required_documents.description: Proof of family membership and entitlement category

required_documents.name: Mobile Number
required_documents.description: For receiving digital Ayushman Card and OTP confirmation

application_steps: Step 1: Check eligibility online at https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in or via the Ayushman App.
Step 2: Enter registered mobile number and verify via OTP.
Step 3: Search family by State, Scheme (PMJAY), Sub-scheme, District, and Family ID (Ration Card Number) or Aadhaar.
Step 4: If family name appears, initiate eKYC for each family member using Aadhaar OTP, Iris, or fingerprint.
Step 5: Upload a live photograph and submit.
Step 6: Download the approved PVC Ayushman Golden Card instantly upon automated approval.

sources.source_name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

investigation.summary: AB-PMJAY covers bottom 40% vulnerable population. Recently expanded to provide ₹5 lakh coverage to all citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income.
findings: No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
Treatment is completely cashless at empaneled hospitals (Ayushman Mitra assists at the hospital helpdesk).
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one with zero waiting period.
fraud_alerts: Ayushman Card generation is 100% free at government hospitals and CSCs. No agent is authorized to charge card issuance fees.
Watch out for fake hospital billing scams or private clinics demanding cash deposits despite holding a valid Ayushman card.
investigation.missing_information: Empaneled hospital lists vary dynamically; users should verify hospital empanelment status before planned admissions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas of India.
benefits: Unit financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP districts. Additional ₹12,000 for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM-G) and 90-95 person-days of unskilled labor under MGNREGS (approx. ₹20,000-₹25,000).

conditions.label: Resident of Rural Area
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must reside in a notified rural Gram Panchayat area.

conditions.label: Does not own a Pucca House
conditions.failure_message: Families already owning a pucca house in their name anywhere in India are ineligible.

conditions.label: Does not own 3/4 wheeler motorized vehicle
conditions.failure_message: Ownership of motorized 3/4-wheeler or mechanized farm equipment disqualifies under auto-exclusion.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
required_documents.description: Mandatory proof of identity

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook with IFSC
required_documents.description: Bank account linked with Aadhaar for phased installment DBT

required_documents.name: MGNREGA Job Card Number
required_documents.description: Required to disburse labor wage component

required_documents.name: Land / Plot Ownership document or Allotment Certificate
required_documents.description: Proof of possession of land where house is to be constructed

application_steps: Step 1: Beneficiary identification is done through the Awaas+ socio-economic survey validated by the Gram Sabha.
Step 2: Contact the Gram Panchayat Secretary or Gram Rozgar Sahayak (GRS) to verify inclusion in the priority list.
Step 3: Registration is uploaded onto the AwaasSoft portal by authorized block/panchayat officials.
Step 4: Geotagging of existing kutcha site by the geo-inspector using the AwaasApp.
Step 5: Administrative approval and release of 1st installment directly into the beneficiary bank account.
Step 6: Construction stages (Plinth, Lintel, Roof completion) are geotagged to trigger subsequent installment disbursements.

sources.source_name: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

investigation.summary: PMAY-G utilizes direct digital geotagging through satellite tracking to prevent ghost beneficiary allocations.
findings: Direct fund disbursement across 3 to 4 milestone-linked installments.
Joint ownership with female spouse is prioritized.
Minimum house size mandated at 25 sq. meters including dedicated hygienic cooking space.
fraud_alerts: Middlemen claiming to 'pass' house sanctions for bribes violate the law; fund sanction is strictly automated based on geotagged photos.
Beneficiaries must never hand over blank signed bank cheques or ATM cards to local contractors.
investigation.missing_information: Landless rural beneficiaries rely on state government provision of homestead plots before construction can commence.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: PMMY provides institutional collateral-free micro-credit up to ₹10 lakh (recently expanded to ₹20 lakh for Tarun Plus) to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for manufacturing, trading, and service activities.
benefits: Collateral-free loans categorized in 3 stages: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (₹5,00,001 to ₹10,00,000). Competitive interest rates, zero processing fee for Shishu loans, and Mudra debit card for working capital withdrawals.

conditions.label: Applicant Age 18 or above
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged at least 18 years.

conditions.label: Eligible Business Sector
conditions.failure_message: Activity must be non-farm income generating micro business.

conditions.label: No previous loan default record
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must not be a wilful defaulter with any formal bank or financial institution.

required_documents.name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
required_documents.description: Government issued photo identification

required_documents.name: Proof of Residence (Utility Bill / Ration Card)
required_documents.description: Verification of current address

required_documents.name: Business Registration / License / Udyam Registration
required_documents.description: Establishment proof or MSME registration certificate

required_documents.name: Bank Account Statements (Past 6 months)
required_documents.description: Demonstrating existing cash flow or transaction history

required_documents.name: Projected Balance Sheet / Quotation for machinery
required_documents.description: Required primarily for Kishore and Tarun category loan applications

application_steps: Step 1: Prepare business plan and determine required loan category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun).
Step 2: Apply online via the Udyamimitra portal (https://www.udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank, RRB, or MFI branch.
Step 3: Fill out the standard MUDRA loan application form.
Step 4: Attach KYC documents, proof of business address, and machinery quotation or expense projection.
Step 5: Bank evaluates project viability and processes sanction without demanding collateral security.
Step 6: Upon approval, receive loan disbursement and MUDRA Card for credit line utilization.

sources.source_name: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

investigation.summary: PMMY is heavily utilized for women entrepreneurs and self-employed micro-enterprises.
findings: No collateral or third-party guarantee can be demanded by banks as per RBI guidelines.
Repayment tenure ranges between 3 to 5 years depending on cash flow projections.
Borrower obtains a Mudra Card (RuPay Debit) enabling anytime working capital withdrawal.
fraud_alerts: MUDRA does NOT disburse loans directly; beware of fake websites claiming to approve loans via WhatsApp on payment of processing/insurance fees.
Government never asks for advance processing commission into private UPI handles.
investigation.missing_information: Individual interest rates vary by lending bank based on credit risk assessment (ranging typically from 8.5% to 12%).

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: SSY is a government-backed savings initiative launched under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign. It provides high guaranteed tax-free returns to secure the future education and marriage expenses of girl children.
benefits: Attractive guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% per annum compounded annually). Triple tax exemption (EEE status under Section 80C). Maturity proceeds are completely exempt from Income Tax.

conditions.label: Beneficiary must be a girl child
conditions.failure_message: SSY accounts can only be opened for a girl child.

conditions.label: Child age up to 10 years
conditions.failure_message: Account must be opened before the girl child attains 10 years of age.

conditions.label: Maximum 2 accounts per family (except twins/triplets)
conditions.failure_message: Maximum of two SSY accounts allowed per family.

required_documents.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
required_documents.description: Official birth certificate issued by municipal authority/registrar

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Parent/Guardian
required_documents.description: Identity and address proof of guardian

required_documents.name: PAN Card of Parent/Guardian
required_documents.description: Required for financial record compliance

required_documents.name: Passport size photographs
required_documents.description: Recent photos of girl child and guardian

application_steps: Step 1: Visit any authorized post office branch or designated commercial public/private sector bank.
Step 2: Collect and fill out the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form (Form-1).
Step 3: Attach birth certificate of the girl child and KYC documents of the parent/guardian.
Step 4: Deposit initial opening amount (minimum ₹250, maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year).
Step 5: The post office/bank will issue a passbook recording all deposits, interest credits, and maturity date.

sources.source_name: Ministry of Finance - Department of Economic Affairs

investigation.summary: SSY remains one of India's highest yielding sovereign guaranteed small savings schemes.
findings: Tenure is 21 years from the date of account opening, or until marriage of the girl child after age 18.
Deposits need to be made only for the first 15 years; remaining 6 years earn interest without deposits.
Partial withdrawal of up to 50% allowed for higher education after child reaches 18 or passes 10th standard.
fraud_alerts: SSY cannot be opened on unverified third-party websites; applications must be lodged at registered bank branches or India Post offices.
investigation.missing_information: Premature closure is strictly regulated, permitted only in extreme cases such as critical medical illness or death of guardian.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: APY is a government-guaranteed pension scheme primarily aimed at workers in the unorganized sector, ensuring a steady guaranteed monthly income post 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting from age 60 until death, followed by same pension to spouse, and return of full pension corpus to nominee.

conditions.label: Minimum Entry Age 18
conditions.failure_message: Entry age must be at least 18 years.

conditions.label: Maximum Entry Age 40
conditions.failure_message: Entry age must not exceed 40 years.

conditions.label: Not an Income Tax Payer
conditions.failure_message: From Oct 1, 2022, citizens who are or have been income tax payers cannot join APY.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Primary identity and address document

required_documents.name: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
required_documents.description: Auto-debit mandate setup for monthly/quarterly contributions

required_documents.name: Mobile Number
required_documents.description: For PRAN confirmation and transaction SMS alerts

application_steps: Step 1: Approach the bank branch or post office where you maintain your savings bank account.
Step 2: Fill out the APY registration form with nominee details and chosen pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000).
Step 3: Authorize monthly auto-debit of the designated contribution amount.
Step 4: Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) acknowledgment via SMS.
Step 5: Track contribution and download e-PRAN from the NSDL/CRA portal (https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in).

sources.source_name: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)

investigation.summary: APY provides sovereign guaranteed retirement security to informal workforce workers who lack organized pension systems.
findings: Contributions are fixed according to age at entry (e.g. at 18, only ₹210/month for ₹5,000 monthly pension).
Government covers any shortfall in investment returns to guarantee specified pension.
Discontinuation of auto-debit triggers nominal penalty charges (₹1 to ₹10 per month).
fraud_alerts: Income tax payers who enrolled illegally after Oct 1, 2022 are subject to account closure and refund of contribution without government co-contribution.
Beware of third-party portals seeking bank PINs to setup APY auto-debit.
investigation.missing_information: Subscribers may upgrade or downgrade their pension amount once during a financial year.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: PM Vishwakarma provides comprehensive support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 designated traditional trades, enhancing their skill quality, toolkits, and market reach.
benefits: Recognition via PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card. Free 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend. Modern toolkit incentive grant of ₹15,000. Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3,00,000 in two tranches (₹1 lakh and ₹2 lakh) at concessional 5% interest rate with 8% interest subvention by GoI.

conditions.label: Minimum age 18 years
conditions.failure_message: Artisan must be at least 18 years of age on date of registration.

conditions.label: Engaged in one of 18 traditional family trades
conditions.failure_message: Must be engaged in recognized traditional crafts (e.g., Carpenter, Blacksmith, Goldsmith, Potter, Cobbler, Tailor, Barber, Mason, etc.).

conditions.label: No government employee in family
conditions.failure_message: Families with government servants are excluded from PM Vishwakarma benefits.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Biometric identification of artisan

required_documents.name: Active Mobile Number
required_documents.description: Linked with Aadhaar for OTP verification

required_documents.name: Bank Account Details
required_documents.description: To credit toolkit grant of ₹15,000 and daily stipend

required_documents.name: Ration Card
required_documents.description: For family verification

application_steps: Step 1: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and bank details.
Step 2: Biometric Aadhaar authentication is carried out at the CSC counter.
Step 3: Select your trade from the 18 eligible traditional crafts (e.g., Badhai, Lohar, Kumhaar, Darzi, etc.).
Step 4: Three-tier verification: Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body verification, followed by District Implementation Committee, and National Screening Committee.
Step 5: Download digital Vishwakarma Certificate and attend designated skill training center.

sources.source_name: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

investigation.summary: PM Vishwakarma marks the first major institutional initiative recognizing India's Guru-Shishya parampara of traditional artisanal crafts.
findings: Covers 18 specific trades including Carpenters, Boat Makers, Armourers, Blacksmiths, Hammer/Tool Kit Makers, Locksmiths, Sculptors, Goldsmiths, Potters, Cobblers, Masons, Basket/Mat/Broom Makers, Doll & Toy Makers, Barbers, Garland Makers, Washermen, Tailors, and Fishing Net Makers.
Only one member per family is eligible for benefits under this scheme.
fraud_alerts: Registration is completely FREE at CSCs (CSC centers are compensated by Government). Do not pay touts demanding processing fees.
The toolkit ₹15,000 is directly provided via digital e-RUPI voucher, not cash transfers.
investigation.missing_information: Credit tranche 2 (₹2,00,000) is accessible only after successful standard repayment of tranche 1.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
hindi_name: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
description: PM Surya Ghar is a national rooftop solar subsidy initiative aimed at providing free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore households across India by subsidizing residential solar panel installations.
benefits: Direct central capital subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW systems, ₹60,000 for 2 kW systems, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW and higher systems. Free electricity up to 300 units/month, with surplus generated power fed back into the grid for revenue.

conditions.label: Active Domestic Electricity Connection
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must have an active residential electricity consumer connection in their name.

conditions.label: Adequate shadow-free rooftop space
conditions.failure_message: Must possess adequate unshaded roof area suitable for solar panel installation.

required_documents.name: Electricity Bill (Latest within 3 months)
required_documents.description: Showing Consumer Account Number and registered DISCOM

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Proof of identity matching electricity bill name

required_documents.name: Bank Account Details (Cancelled Cheque)
required_documents.description: For direct receipt of subsidy into beneficiary account

required_documents.name: Rooftop Ownership Document / Proof
required_documents.description: Proof of ownership or permission from building society

application_steps: Step 1: Register on the National Portal (https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in) with State, Electricity Distribution Company (DISCOM), and Consumer Account Number.
Step 2: Apply for Rooftop Solar installation through online portal form.
Step 3: Receive technical feasibility approval from your local DISCOM.
Step 4: Select a registered/empaneled vendor to install the solar plant.
Step 5: Apply for net metering and inspection by DISCOM engineer upon completion.
Step 6: DISCOM issues commissioning certificate; upload bank details to receive subsidy within 30 days.

sources.source_name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)

investigation.summary: Flagship scheme replacing the earlier National Rooftop Solar Programme, offering higher upfront direct subsidies and seamless digital tracking.
findings: Concessional collateral-free bank loans available at around 7% interest for the non-subsidized portion.
Subsidy is credited directly via DBT to beneficiary bank account within 30 days of net meter commissioning.
fraud_alerts: Only install through DISCOM-empaneled vendors listed on pmsuryaghar.gov.in; unapproved vendors cannot generate commissioning certificates.
Beware of unauthorized agents demanding cash processing fees.
investigation.missing_information: High-rise apartment societies require shared rooftop consensus and group net-metering approval.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (MP)
description: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana is the flagship welfare scheme of the Government of Madhya Pradesh, empowering women financially, fostering self-reliance, and improving the health and nutritional status of women and their families.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 transferred directly into the DBT-enabled Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of eligible women on the 10th of every calendar month (₹15,000 annually).

conditions.label: Permanent Resident of Madhya Pradesh
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must be a bonafide permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.

conditions.label: Gender is Female
conditions.failure_message: Only women are eligible.

conditions.label: Minimum age 21 years
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must be at least 21 years of age.

conditions.label: Maximum age 60 years
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must not have completed 60 years of age.

conditions.label: Family Annual Income ≤ ₹2,50,000
conditions.failure_message: Combined annual family income must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.

conditions.label: Family landholding ≤ 5 acres
conditions.failure_message: Family must not own more than 5 acres of agricultural land.

conditions.label: Family does not own four-wheeler (except tractor)
conditions.failure_message: Families owning a four-wheeler motor vehicle (excluding farm tractors) are excluded.

required_documents.name: Samagra Family ID and Member ID (Samagra e-KYC completed)
required_documents.description: Mandatory 9-digit member Samagra ID verified with Aadhaar

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Mandatory identity document linked to Samagra and bank

required_documents.name: Individual Bank Account (Aadhaar Linked & DBT Active)
required_documents.description: Must not be a joint account; DBT activation is compulsory

required_documents.name: Registered Mobile Number
required_documents.description: For receiving OTP and monthly disbursement SMS

application_steps: Step 1: Ensure individual bank account is Aadhaar linked and DBT-enabled via your bank branch.
Step 2: Complete Samagra e-KYC via MPOnline / CSC or Samagra portal (samagra.gov.in).
Step 3: Attend special registration camps organized in your Gram Panchayat or Ward office.
Step 4: The camp official enters your Samagra ID, captures your live photograph, and submits form online.
Step 5: Receive paper acknowledgment receipt with unique application number.
Step 6: Provisional beneficiary list is published for public claims & objections before final authorization.

sources.source_name: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

investigation.summary: Flagship direct transfer scheme in MP with over 1.29 crore enrolled women beneficiaries. Transparent DBT transfers on the 10th of every month.
findings: Unmarried women are not eligible; eligible categories are Married, Widowed, Divorced, and Abandoned women.
DBT enablement at the bank branch is the single most common reason for failed transactions.
Joint bank accounts with husbands are not accepted; an individual savings account is mandatory.
fraud_alerts: No official form can be submitted on random cyber cafe websites; registration is strictly carried out through official camp officials with live webcam photos.
Beware of phone calls asking for bank PIN or OTP to 'unfreeze' Ladli Behna installments.
investigation.missing_information: Women currently benefiting from other state pension schemes receiving ₹600/month receive the differential amount up to ₹1,250.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0) Yojana (MP)
description: Sambal 2.0 provides comprehensive social security and financial assistance to unorganized sector workers and their families in Madhya Pradesh, covering maternity, education, healthcare, disability, and death benefits.
benefits: Maternity assistance of ₹16,000 for women workers. Ex-gratia assistance of ₹4,00,000 in case of accidental death, ₹2,00,000 for normal death, ₹2,00,000 for permanent disability, and ₹1,00,000 for partial disability. Funeral assistance of ₹5,000. Free education scheme for children of registered workers.

conditions.label: Resident of Madhya Pradesh
conditions.failure_message: Applicant must reside permanently in Madhya Pradesh.

conditions.label: Worker in Unorganized Sector
conditions.failure_message: Must be engaged in informal/unorganized labor without formal PF/ESI coverage.

conditions.label: Minimum age 18 years
conditions.failure_message: Must be at least 18 years of age.

conditions.label: Maximum age 60 years
conditions.failure_message: Must be below 60 years of age.

conditions.label: Landholding ≤ 1 hectare (approx 2.5 acres)
conditions.failure_message: Landholding must not exceed 1 hectare.

required_documents.name: Samagra ID (Complete e-KYC)
required_documents.description: Mandatory family and member Samagra identifier

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Proof of identity

required_documents.name: Self-Declaration of Unorganized Worker
required_documents.description: Signed declaration regarding non-agricultural informal trade

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook Details
required_documents.description: Aadhaar-linked DBT enabled account

application_steps: Step 1: Visit the official Sambal portal (https://sambal.mp.gov.in).
Step 2: Click on 'Register for Sambal' and input Samagra ID and Member ID.
Step 3: Verify Samagra e-KYC data pulled automatically from UIDAI.
Step 4: Select specific unorganized employment category and upload self-declaration.
Step 5: Application is inquired and certified by local Inquiry Officer (Panchayat Secretary or Ward In-charge).
Step 6: Download the Sambal Card upon approval.

sources.source_name: Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

investigation.summary: Sambal 2.0 re-engineered the earlier Sambal card scheme with biometric re-verification to eliminate fake beneficiaries.
findings: Provides cradle-to-grave social security net for informal workers in MP.
Includes Super 500 scheme financing college entrance coaching for top children of Sambal workers.
Electricity bill waiver schemes also link directly to Sambal card holders.
fraud_alerts: Holders of government jobs, income tax payers, or holders of more than 1 hectare land cannot register; wrongful registration attracts recovery and penalty.
Beware of unauthorized agents selling fake physical laminated cards.
investigation.missing_information: Claims for death or disability must be filed within 90 days of the incident with medical/postmortem certificates.

name: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Vivah / Nikah Yojana (MP)
hindi_name: मुख्यमंत्री कन्या विवाह / निकाह योजना (मध्य प्रदेश)
description: Financial assistance program by the Government of Madhya Pradesh to support the marriage expenses of daughters of poor, destitute, and needy families, widows, and divorcees participating in mass wedding ceremonies.
benefits: Total assistance of ₹55,000 per bride. ₹49,000 transferred directly to the bride's bank account for purchasing household establishment items, and ₹6,000 paid to the organizing municipal body/panchayat for mass wedding ceremony arrangements.

conditions.label: Resident of Madhya Pradesh
conditions.failure_message: Bride's guardian/family must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.

conditions.label: Bride age at least 18 years
conditions.failure_message: Bride must have completed 18 years of age at the time of wedding.

conditions.label: Groom age at least 21 years
conditions.failure_message: Groom must have completed 21 years of age.

conditions.label: Participating in authorized collective mass marriage
conditions.failure_message: Marriage must be solemnized in an officially notified mass marriage (Samoohik Vivah) event.

required_documents.name: Samagra ID of Bride and Groom
required_documents.description: Mandatory MP identity document

required_documents.name: Age Proof of Bride and Groom (10th marksheet or Birth Certificate)
required_documents.description: Verifying legal marriage age

required_documents.name: BPL / Poor Family Certificate or Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Proof of economic eligibility

required_documents.name: Bride's Individual Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Aadhaar linked for DBT transfer

application_steps: Step 1: Obtain application form from the local Gram Panchayat, Janpad Panchayat, or Municipal Corporation.
Step 2: Fill in details of both bride and groom, attaching age, residence, and income proofs.
Step 3: Submit application at least 15 days prior to the announced mass marriage event date.
Step 4: Local revenue authority conducts spot verification.
Step 5: Attend the designated mass wedding ceremony with solemnization certificate issued on-site.
Step 6: Financial assistance is credited directly into bride's savings bank account.

sources.source_name: Social Justice & Disabled Welfare Department, MP

investigation.summary: A flagship social reform initiative designed to eliminate dowry burden and prevent child marriage by tying cash transfers directly to verified age.
findings: Underage marriages are strictly eliminated through mandatory biometric and documentary verification of age.
Cash transfer is made solely to the bride to safeguard her economic independence.
fraud_alerts: Private weddings are NOT eligible; marriage must take place in an official administrative mass ceremony.
Beware of agents who demand cuts or commissions from the bride's ₹49,000 disbursement.
investigation.missing_information: Widows and legally divorced women are also eligible if they have not previously drawn assistance under this scheme.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY) (MP)
description: MMVY provides complete tuition fee reimbursement for meritorious 12th pass students from Madhya Pradesh admitted to top undergraduate courses, engineering (IIT/NIT), medical (NEET/MBBS), law (CLAT), and premier institutions across India.
benefits: Complete academic tuition fee reimbursement directly paid to the university/college, ensuring meritorious students never drop out due to inability to pay high professional college fees.

conditions.label: Domicile of Madhya Pradesh
conditions.failure_message: Student must be a bonafide resident/domicile of Madhya Pradesh.

conditions.label: Family annual income ≤ ₹6,00,000
conditions.failure_message: Parents' combined annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹6 lakh.

conditions.label: Minimum 70% in MP Board or 85% in CBSE/ICSE
conditions.failure_message: Must have secured at least 70% in MP Board or 85% in CBSE/ICSE in 12th standard.

required_documents.name: Class 12th Marksheet
required_documents.description: Proving required percentage threshold

required_documents.name: MP Domicile Certificate (Mool Niwas)
required_documents.description: Proof of Madhya Pradesh residence

required_documents.name: Income Certificate (Current)
required_documents.description: Issued by authorized Tehsildar showing family income < ₹6 lakh

required_documents.name: College Admission Allotment Letter & Fee Structure
required_documents.description: Proof of admission to recognized course/institute

required_documents.name: Samagra ID & Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Digital KYC verification

application_steps: Step 1: Secure admission to an eligible degree course through national/state counseling.
Step 2: Register on the State Scholarship 2.0 / MMVY portal (https://scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in/MedhaviChhatra/).
Step 3: Fill student registration with 12th roll number, Samagra ID, and Aadhaar.
Step 4: Upload income certificate, domicile certificate, and college admission fee receipt.
Step 5: Institute verifies the application through their institutional nodal login.
Step 6: State Higher Education Department sanctions and disburses the course tuition fee directly to the institute.

sources.source_name: Higher Education Department, Government of MP

investigation.summary: One of India's most generous merit scholarships, covering 100% of college tuition at IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, and National Law Universities for MP domicile students.
findings: Covers government colleges and selected premier private university courses.
Medical students funded under MMVY sign a bond to serve in government rural health centers for 2 years (or refund the sanctioned fee).
Renewal in subsequent academic years requires passing exams without backlogs.
fraud_alerts: Submitting forged income certificates or fake domicile papers results in blacklisting and legal recovery proceedings.
Portal applications are 100% online; no hardcopy submission to third parties is valid.
investigation.missing_information: Mess fees and hostel living costs are not covered under MMVY tuition reimbursements.
